acceptanceCriteria: Cargo workspace version and lockfile packages are consistently bumped from 0.2.18 to 0.2.19, with no unrelated dependency drift.
Tri-language release/versioning/distribution documentation and reference parity identify v0.2.19 consistently and link the public release evidence after publication.
All repository quality, documentation, conformance, release policy, and package checks pass before publication; no source fallback is used for post-release acceptance.

The public v0.2.19 binary passes adopter acceptance and v0.2.18-to-v0.2.19 N-1 upgrade acceptance, including finalize-plan, finalize, finalize-verify, close, cleanup, runtime identity, and isolation assertions.
The original v0.2.18 adopter/upgrade failure receipt remains immutable and is not rewritten by this release.
The Work Item completes start → preflight → checkpoint → finalize-plan → verify → finish → archive → finalize → finalize-verify → visible human Outcome → close with current Runtime evidence.
goal: 发布 v0.2.19，并用公开 Release binary 验证资源收尾修复后的 adopter 与 N-1 upgrade 闭环。
intent: 将 WI-166 合并后的 post-release acceptance harness 发布为 v0.2.19，证明从公开 immutable binary 开始可完成真实治理生命周期，同时保留 v0.2.18 的失败事实。
outOfScope: 改写 v0.2.18 Release、receipt 或公开历史证据
